description.en: Handcrafted React UI components and calm motion for AI apps with zero CSS dependencies.
description.zh: 面向 AI 产品与 SaaS 的纯手工 React 动效组件库，单文件自包含样式，零额外 CSS 依赖。

content.en: affectUI is a handcrafted library of polished React components, illustrations, and calm motion effects tailored for AI applications and modern SaaS. Every component is delivered as a single self-contained TSX file with embedded styling, requiring no Tailwind, external CSS setup, or third-party animation libraries. It supports installation via the shadcn CLI or direct copy-paste, offering native dark mode, WCAG accessibility, and container query responsiveness out of the box.
content.zh: affectUI 是一套专为 AI 原生产品与现代 SaaS 打造的高水准 React 组件、插画与动效合集。所有组件均以单文件形式交付且内置样式，完全不依赖 Tailwind、外部 CSS 配置或第三方动画引擎。支持通过 shadcn CLI 一键引入或直接复制源码，原生支持暗色模式、无障碍键盘交互与容器查询自适应布局。
